result.title: Ensemble Methodology for Reference-Free Confidence Estimation in LLM-based Code Summarization
result.summary: This paper describes an approach and use case to estimate the correctness of LLM-generated COBOL summaries without access to human-authored references. The core intuition is that inter-model agreement on semantics is informative about truth, and that an LLM-as-judge can provide higher-fidelity pairwise assessments than traditional string- or embedding-based metrics. We operationalise this intuition with (i) controlled summary generation from diverse models; (ii) a LLM evaluator that compares pairs of summaries and emits structured judgments; and (iii) a calibrated aggregation rule that combines supportive evidence while penalising only corroborated contradictions.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出一种无需人工参考的 COBOL 代码摘要置信度估计流程：由多模型受控生成摘要，用 LLM-as-judge 做成对结构化评判，再以校准的聚合规则汇总支持性证据并仅惩罚已被证实的矛盾。
AI.relevance_reason: 「模型间语义一致即可信」「只惩罚被佐证的矛盾」这类无参考置信度思路，可能为 LVR 中基于多假设一致性的答案核验与 STOP 决策提供概念参考；但任务为纯文本代码摘要，迁移到视觉证据与 latent 假设仍需核查。
